setup: Actual TanStack app and server functions. Test-only requireWorkspace uses an isolated migrated PGlite database; Clerk and Neon connections are not exercised.

results.name: Workspace lookup time counts toward the same deadline before the event read
A late Result rolls back a changed shared-state value as well as its event and cursor
Nine queued clicks wrap the eight-event script with unique ids and updated state
If the selected id disappears, the inspector shows the last available event
A caller without a deadline receives a fresh window and commits one event
